name: James M. Cook
bio: James M. "Jim" Cook was Studebaker Bros.' adjusting agent for the Northwest, whose visits to Medora in 1884 the Cow Boy greeted warmly. In January 1885 the paper reported that he had taken a better position with the Walter A. Wood firm.
